item_name: Black Ink Death Spade Low Profile Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: The Death Spade Low Profile Insignia Cap, designed by Black Ink, is a nod to a powerful symbol that dates back to the Vietnam War. The front panel of this baseball cap prominently features an intricately embroidered death spade—a bold, solid black spade with a centered skull and bones, signifying strength and resilience. Crafted from 100% brushed cotton twill, this rugged cap offers both durability and comfort, making it perfect for all-day wear.
